fragments.derivationNote: Pinned OHM 1552-1556 reconstruction promoted only after exact relation/version check, distributed spatial controls and independent Russian documentary corroboration for Kazan.
Pinned OHM 1556-1595 reconstruction promoted only for the pre-Siberian interval after exact relation/version check, distributed spatial controls and Russian archival corroboration for Astrakhan.

historicalDate.original: 2 октября 1552 г. по юлианскому календарю / 12 октября 1552 г. по григорианскому календарю — взятие Казани и ликвидация Казанского ханства

baseStates.notes: Activation begins in the exact Gregorian month of the Kazan conquest. The state is bounded through August 1556, immediately before the normalized September 1556 Astrakhan incorporation.

historicalDate.original: 26 августа 1556 г. по юлианской хронологии Президентской библиотеки / 5 сентября 1556 г. по григорианскому календарю — окончательное присоединение Астраханского ханства

baseStates.notes: The state includes Kazan and Astrakhan but excludes the later Siberian conquest area. It is therefore stopped before the earliest 1581 Yermak/Siberia chronology rather than stretched to the OHM relation's nominal 1595 end date.
